answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch opens a terrace of 20 slots, and agents bid; only the highest bidders enter, so a walnut seller must outbid fakes. A cheater minting 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 auctions, paying 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 coins in bids, while idle fakes earn nothing, so the attack loses money. Honest agents bid once and earn undiluted rewards; agents that wander in without a winning bid are turned away.
